components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Neumorphic rose key: scrim face, 1px lip, sinks on hover and press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.14), oklch(1 0 0 / 0) 60%), oklch(0.55 0.21 17); color: oklch(0.99 0.005 17); font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.25), inset 0 -1px 0 oklch(0.42 0.18 17 / 0.5), 0 1px 0 oklch(0.42 0.17 17 / 0.9), 0 3px 7px -3px oklch(0.3 0.12 17 / 0.3); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.25), inset 0 -1px 0 oklch(0.42 0.18 17 / 0.5), 0 0 0 oklch(0.42 0.17 17 / 0.9), 0 2px 5px -2px oklch(0.3 0.12 17 / 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px oklch(0.35 0.15 17 / 0.45); }

components.name: Input Tray
components.description: Debossed pill tray holding an input and the primary key.
components.css: .ds-tray { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.995 0.003 17); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px 4px oklch(0.82 0.028 20 / 0.3), inset -1px -1px 4px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.6), 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.28 0.022 20 / 0.1); } .ds-tray:focus-within { outline: 1px solid oklch(0.28 0.022 20 / 0.3); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tray-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: none; background: transparent; padding: 12px 16px; font: inherit; color: oklch(0.28 0.022 20); outline: none; } .ds-tray-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.47 0.03 20); }

components.name: Marker-Swipe Link
components.description: Text link with a rotated periwinkle band that sweeps to full on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { --c: oklch(0.52 0.16 258); position: relative; z-index: 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 250ms 33ms cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-link::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: -0.15rem; left: -0.1rem; height: 0.6em; z-index: -1; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--c), transparent 85%); transform: rotateZ(-1deg); transition: background-color 250ms 33ms cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), transform 250ms 33ms cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-link:hover { color: white; } .ds-link:hover::before { background: var(--c); transform: translateY(-50%) rotateZ(0.35deg) scaleY(2); }

components.name: App Card
components.description: Routine/product card as rendered in the mobile app.
components.html: The OrdinarySerum z niacynamidem
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-card-brand { color: #E11D48; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-name { color: #292524; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Rhythm Dot
components.description: One day in the 14-day rhythm strip; on-days glow night-rose.
components.css: .ds-dot { display: inline-block; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.13); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-dot-on { background: oklch(0.72 0.14 14); } .ds-dot-on:hover { transform: scale(1.45); box-shadow: 0 0 10px oklch(0.72 0.14 14 / 0.5); }

components.name: FAQ Row
components.description: Night-section details row with rotating plus toggle.
components.html:

Podstawowa wersja będzie darmowa.
components.css: .ds-faq { border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.33 0.05 4); background: oklch(0.2 0.042 4); color: oklch(0.945 0.014 10); } .ds-faq-q { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 20px 0; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-faq-q:hover { color: white; } .ds-faq-q::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq-icon { color: oklch(0.76 0.05 10); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-faq[open] .ds-faq-icon { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq-a { max-width: 60ch; padding-bottom: 24px; color: oklch(0.76 0.05 10); margin: 0; }

narrative.northStar: Twoja cera ma swój rytm — The Day's Rhythm
narrative.overview: Every Cera surface knows what time it is. The app renders the same routine under two lights — Stone-white mornings and Stone-900 evenings, marked in-product with Sun/Moon icons. The landing compresses that day into one scroll: leaf-shadowed morning, mesh twilight, plum night. Light is the narrative material; calm is the register; warmth comes from light, texture, and soft-tactile controls.
keyCharacteristics: One day, two themes: every color has a Rano and a Wieczór answer
Rose is identity and action; it never decorates
Soft-tactile controls — things you press, gently
Real app screenshots as the only product imagery

rules.name: The One Rose Rule
rules.body: Rose marks identity and primary action — never decoration, never large surfaces.

rules.name: The Gradient Space Rule
rules.body: Multi-stop background blends interpolate in oklch; sRGB gray midpoints are prohibited.

rules.name: The Two-Weights-Apart Rule
rules.body: Adjacent hierarchy levels differ by ≥140 weight units or a full size step.

rules.name: The One Object Rule
rules.body: Only the phone frame earns a large drop shadow; it is the single physically lifted thing on any screen.

dos: Do give every new surface a time of day; pick tokens from that ramp, never mix ramps in one component.
Do interpolate multi-color gradients in oklch and hide banding under the 6% grain.
Do use real app screenshots (per-locale, seeded data) for product imagery.
Do keep body text ≥16px at ≥4.5:1; drop dark-section body weight to 380.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion with visible-by-default states.
donts: Don't use beauty-influencer aesthetics: glossy gradients, sparkle, glow-up hype.
Don't slip into clinical/pharma coldness — sterile white, blue crosses, lab language.
Don't reach for SaaS landing grammar: hero-metric blocks, identical card grids, eyebrow kickers.
Don't make medical claims in UI copy; serious problems route to a doctor.
Don't put rose on large surfaces or use it as a text-link color.
Don't use slang in copy; the voice is a knowledgeable friend, unhurried.
